extraction_notes: The supplied PDF title is BC856-BC858 and the electrical-characteristics table explicitly lists BC857B with hFE limits 220 to 475 at VCE = -5 V and IC = -2 mA.
The PDF does not state a revision, so datasheet_identity.revision is recorded as not stated rather than inferred.

Page 3 typical-characteristics plots are labeled BC856/BC857/BC858 and are treated as shared family evidence applicable to BC857B. Curve points are sparse approximate manual digitizations of visible traces at labeled grid positions; no points were interpolated between plotted observations.

PNP collector-current, base-current, collector-emitter-voltage, base-emitter-voltage, VCEsat, and VBEsat coordinates retain the datasheet negative signs. Curve axes labeled in mA, pF, and MHz were represented in SI units A, F, and Hz.
The hFE table gives BC857B a guaranteed range of 220 to 475 at VCE = -5 V and IC = -2 mA. The two gain_points preserve minimum and maximum semantics and do not invent a typical value.

The table provides one guaranteed maximum VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) pair at IC = -100 mA and IB = -5 mA. The plotted saturation traces are typical curves at beta = 20 and remain separate from the guaranteed table values.

Cob is a guaranteed maximum table value at VCB = -10 V. The page 3 Cib curve is retained as typical digitized curve evidence, but cibo remains null because the supplied table gives no numeric Cib specification.
The table fT entry is a guaranteed minimum at IC = -10 mA and VCE = -5 V with measurement frequency f = 100 MHz; the page 3 fT curve is typical family evidence.
